articles.summary: AMTD Group Inc. ("AMTD Group"), AMTD IDEA Group ("AMTD IDEA") (NYSE: AMTD; SGX: HKB), AMTD Digital Inc. ("AMTD Digital") (NYSE: HKD) and The Generation Essentials Group ("TGE") (NYSE: TGE; LSE: TGE), a subsidiary of AMTD Digital, jointly (together, the "Group" or "AMTD") announce AMTD is in negotiation as a final stage bidder in relation to the acquisition of a second hotel in New York City. In March 2026, AMTD successfully acquired a hotel located at 39 6th Ave, New York, NY 10013, for a cash consideration of USD69 million, which has now been rebranded successfully as the AMTD IDEA Tribeca Hotel. The newly targeted property is located strategically in the Time Square area. The relevant parties are currently in final negotiation stage and are working towards a definitive purchase agreement, with a target closing date prior to the end of 2026.
